customerDefinition.launchCustomer: United States resident with a specific civic issue who wants official outreach handled for a small single-payment fee.

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up assumption model because no external research is available in workspace-only mode.
marketSizing.addressableIntentEvents: 500,000 annual paid-intent events [assumption: placeholder for United States resident civic issues; no external source available offline]
marketSizing.serviceableReachableEvents: 50,000 annual reachable events [assumption: ten percent of assumed addressable intent]
marketSizing.earlyObtainablePaidSubmissions: 5,000 annual paid submissions [assumption: one percent of assumed addressable intent]

financialFigures.planningScenario: $5,200 monthly gross revenue [assumption: 400 paid submissions times $13 blended price]
financialFigures.variableCost: $160 monthly variable cost [assumption: 400 submissions times $0.40 blended job cost]
financialFigures.dataProvider: $100-$500 per month [assumption: inherited from .planning/PROJECT.md; not externally verified]

sequence: Closed beta with directly recruited residents.
Measure checkout conversion against the 3% gate [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
Expand into consented public pages and SEO only after moderation and data quality are proven.
goToMarket.paidAcquisition: Do not start before conversion and deliverability are proven.

holes.mitigation: Closed beta with Stripe test and then live payment validation.
holes.residualRisk: Users may like the concept but refuse to pay.

holes.hole: Government inbox delivery and official response quality unproven.
holes.mitigation: Instrument bounce, spam complaint, deliverability, and reply rates.
holes.residualRisk: Officials may ignore or filter AI-assisted correspondence.

holes.hole: Legal-adjacent content can create defamation, threat, privacy, and advice-risk exposure.
holes.mitigation: Keep moderation, citation verification, disclaimers, and admin review as launch blockers.
holes.residualRisk: False negatives or citation errors could still create trust damage.

holes.hole: Standalone market may be too small for venture outcomes.
holes.mitigation: Treat as Watchlist until repeatable acquisition and expansion paths are proven.
holes.residualRisk: It may remain a useful tool rather than an investible company.

risksAntiPlan.antiPlan: Do not pitch as investment-ready, scale paid ads, sell to organizations, or claim moat until paid conversion, delivery, coverage, and exception workload are proven.

assumptionLedger: Residents will pay $5-$25 for the workflow [assumption pending beta].
Email-first delivery is enough [assumption pending deliverability and reply data].
AI citations can be verified reliably [assumption pending defect-rate measurement].
One operator can handle flagged content [assumption pending queue-age and review-time data].
The operator wants this pitched as a business [assumption pending operator confirmation].
